title: SevenZipExtractionConfig
description: Schema defining parameters for 7z extraction and hardware dispatch

archivePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the source .7z or split-volume file

destinationDir.description: Target directory path for extracted files

skipMacJunk.description: Whether to filter AppleDouble and .DS_Store artifacts

enableHardwareCrypto.description: Whether ARM64 NEON hardware AES-256 and SHA-256 KDF are engaged

useDirectoryCache.description: Whether L1/L2 stack directory caching is active for APFS write reduction
